name: Warrior Grand Prix Championship
notes: The trophy and belt promised to the winner of BodyCount's own single-elimination Warrior Grand Prix tournament; awarded once, on the corpus's own record, at the close of the first tournament in October 2012. A second tournament was announced in 2015 but never reached a result.
epitaph: A one-off tournament belt, won once and never again defended on the record this pass could recover.
